profit_quality.assessment: 2023 turned profitable with strong operating cash flow and low capital expenditure, but only two complete post-listing years are available in this annual report and 2022 reported profit was distorted by preferred-share fair value losses. The denominator therefore uses a conservative cash-profit estimate below 2023 adjusted net profit and applies a 0.65 haircut.
adjustments: Company adjusted net profit adds back RMB251.711m share-based payments and RMB4.853m preferred-share fair value losses to RMB445.130m.
2023 operating cash flow of RMB587.839m less capital expenditure of RMB56.254m gives operating free cash flow of about RMB531.585m.

Main pre-haircut distributable cash profit is set at RMB360m, below 2023 adjusted net profit, to avoid capitalising one strong recovery year and to reserve for employee incentive economics and education-sector volatility.

Profit haircut factor is 0.65 because revenue depends on recruitment examination demand, prepaid/refundable course obligations, and the annual report does not provide a full three-year cash-flow sample.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2023 OCF/RMB188.566m reported net profit equals about 3.12x; OCF less capex was RMB531.585m.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Strong current cash conversion but limited multi-year post-listing evidence and meaningful employee incentive/operating obligation uncertainty.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: 2023 conversion was strong; 2022 was cash-flow negative and reported loss was heavily affected by preferred-share fair value losses.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Capital expenditure was RMB56.254m in 2023 and mainly PPE purchases; low versus operating cash flow.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Contract liabilities increased to RMB149.487m and refund liabilities remained RMB227.067m, so prepaid-course obligations require an operating cash buffer.
